title: CollectiveX: graph-replay every capturable EP backend with rank alignment and the chained period
body:
Graph-replays each EP backend where it's that library's fastest configuration that passes every check, plus nccl-ep HT decode, which replays because a captured decode step would run it that way. It also fixes graph timing, so graphed and eager rows measure the same thing.

## Harness
- **Rank-aligned replay.** Each timed replay starts behind a device-side rank barrier: an all-reduce, then a spin of fixed *wall time*, with no host sync. The spin is converted to cycles per GPU by measuring its spin rate. A fixed cycle count left ~15 µs of skew between differently clocked ranks. Timing events are graph nodes.
- **Graphed fresh-entry tails are withheld.** `roundtrip`, `dispatch`, `combine` and `cross_rank_min` publish only p50 under replay. A rank whose host launches its replay late still stalls the others, and those stalls own p90–p99 (gb200 T=1 roundtrip p99 858 µs vs combine p99 30 µs).
- **The chained family comes back under graphs.** Each chain sibling is one graph of unrolled pairs, the shape of a decode graph. `pair_period` keeps its tails, and the chained oracle runs.
- **Every graphed row is value-checked.** An untimed capture puts `stage()` inside the graph. What dispatch wrote and the combined output are filled with 0xFF bytes (NaN) before its replay, and the result must match an eager drained pair. Previously, FP8 and hoisted-staging rows (e.g. flashinfer) had only a finite-output check.
- Graphed rows get a `-cudagraph` suffix on `kernel_generation`.

## Per-library configuration
| Backend / mode | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| deepep-v2 LL | graph | |
| deepep-v2 normal decode | graph, `do_cpu_sync=False`, receive sized to the next power of two of T | vLLM's graphed `deepep_v2` decode contract; `v2-elastic-buffer-nosync` |
| deepep-v2 normal prefill | eager, host sync | unchanged |
| uccl-ep LL | graph, intranode only; eager on b200 FP8 | scale-out goes through the CPU proxy, never validated under capture |
| uccl-ep normal | eager | capturing it would need `num_worst_tokens` padding (not done) |
| flashinfer-ep | graph for decode, eager for prefill | decode gain is removed host overhead |
| nccl-ep LL | graph, rank-major (TensorRT-LLM's NCCL EP contract) | `COLLX_NCCL_LL_LAYOUT=expert-major` gives the like-for-like row (`nccl-ep-v02-ll-em`) |
| nccl-ep HT | graph for decode, eager for prefill; zero-copy, full static combine input (`-zc-static`) | see below |
| MoRI | eager | graph replay split out to #3453 (stacked on this PR) |

**The rank-major nccl-ep LL win is mostly contract, not kernel.** Rank-major moves ~27% fewer wire bytes (b200 EP8 T=8: 281 vs 384 copies), and within one scale-up domain it's also the zero-copy variant. Where neither variant is zero-copy (b200 EP16) the gap is ~2%. The artifacts record both bases (`byte_provenance` vs `wire_byte_provenance`).

**nccl-ep HT:**
- The combine input now gets the full static `[num_recv_slots, hidden]` plane that the FLAT contract requires. It was previously sliced to the received count.
- The earlier graphed HT failures were the correctness oracle's own unfenced write into the zero-copy window. That write is now fenced across ranks.
- Graphed HT is then correct, but 1.03–1.11× eager's pair period on h100/h200 EP16. Decode replays anyway, because engines capture the decode step; prefill stays eager because engines run it uncaptured.
- The graphed cost is NCCL's: captured, the per-step routing `ncclAllGather` is a cross-node collective driven by NCCL's proxy, and NCCL puts a host-callback node in front of it on every replay (`enqueue.cc`). That is about +50 µs of dispatch at EP16, and nothing within one node.

## Disclosure: MI325X routing change (b25ca14a8)
MoRI low-latency on `mi325x` is since dropped (94f43b536): it fails eager there (run 36189510167), independent of graphs.

This branch includes a teammate's MI325X fix. It drops the `mi325x-tw` pool and enables `mori:[8]`, `uccl-ep:[8]` and LL `mori:[8]` on the Slurm `mi325x` pool (`mi-amds` launcher), and edits `collectivex-sweep.yml`. The MI325X runner label now lives in the platform registry (`runner_label`, read into each matrix cell's `runner`) instead of a special case in the workflow. It's gfx942, the same architecture on which MoRI AsyncLL hit a device assertion on mi300x-tw (eager, also on the pre-#3370 baseline). The validation sweeps below include it.

## Validation
Unit tests pass: 117, 8 skipped.

Earlier config shootout:
- [36113759089](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36113759089): graphs on
- [36114371399](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36114371399): graphs off
- [36114373789](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36114373789): pre-#3370 baseline
- [36114376388](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36114376388): nccl-ep expert-major LL

Validation of this revision (results to follow in a comment):
- Two full sweeps: [36176082494](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36176082494), [36176091366](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36176091366)
- nccl-ep HT eager: [36176100175](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36176100175), for 3 eager HT runs in total
- nccl-ep HT graphed ×3: [36176104016](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36176104016), [36176112858](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36176112858), [36176121998](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36176121998)

title: CollectiveX: graph-replay MoRI (ROCm event capture via hipEventRecordWithFlags)
body:
Stacked on #3437 (base `cx-graphs-rank-major`). Retarget to `main` once that merges.

Graph-replays MoRI in both modes. It uses #3437's graph harness: rank-aligned replay, the chained pair period under capture, and the poisoned replay value check.

## Change
- **ROCm event path.** ROCm torch before 2.13 rejects `torch.cuda.Event(external=True)` ("External events are disallowed in rocm"), even though HIP ≥ 7 supports external event records inside a capture. The event is created normally, recorded once outside capture, and its in-capture record goes through `hipEventRecordWithFlags(..., hipEventRecordExternal)` via ctypes. That is the call torch 2.13 makes itself (pytorch#178264). CUDA backends are unchanged.
- **`ep_mori.py`: `CUDA_GRAPH_MODES = ("normal", "low-latency")`.** MoRI's kernels launch with host-built args only (the reset moved on-device in ROCm/mori#86 for vLLM's graphs), and MoRI's own benchmark captures IntraNode dispatch/combine.
- Unit tests for the HIP record path: 120 pass, 8 skipped.

## Validation
Two full sweeps of #3437 with this change included: [36189493665](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36189493665), [36189496984](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36189496984).

**Every MoRI cell passed every check in both runs:** mi355x and mi325x, normal and low-latency, EP8 and EP16, bf16 and fp8. That includes the poisoned graph-replay value check and the chained oracle.

Pair period p50, graphed vs eager (eager from [36114371399](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36114371399)), geomean over the ladder:

| mi355x case | graph / eager | T=1 (µs) |
|---|---|---|
| LL decode EP8 bf16 | 0.79 | 90 → 56 |
| LL decode EP8 fp8 | 0.77 | 95 → 58 |
| normal decode EP8 bf16 / fp8 | 0.98 / 0.95 | 44 → 42 / 49 → 42 |
| normal decode EP16 bf16 / fp8 | 1.00 / 1.00 | 175 → 175 |
| normal prefill EP8 / EP16 | 0.98–1.00 | |

mi325x has no earlier eager MoRI baseline in these sweeps. Its graphed rows are correct in both runs, e.g. normal decode EP8 bf16 T=1 = 39 µs.

MoRI low-latency on mi325x stays off: it fails **eager** on that pool (run [36189510167](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36189510167)), independent of graphs. #3437 drops that leg.

title: Add B200 TP2 V4 Flash SGLang 8k1k MTP sweep / 新增 B200 TP2 V4 Flash SGLang 8k1k MTP 扫描
body:
## Description

Add `dsv4flash-fp4-b200-sglang-mtp` for the exact `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` checkpoint on B200 Nscale: TP2, 8192 input / 1024 output tokens, concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128.

- The requester confirmed the same bundled MTP setup as [B300 PR #3516](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3516): `EAGLE`, 3 steps, top-k 1, 4 draft tokens, not the separate EAGLE3 algorithm.
- Pin the same official SGLang CUDA 13 nightly `nightly-dev-cu13-20260925-8ca82118` and amd64 digest. Keep weights and KV on GPU, real verification, and the checkpoint's shipped draft head. Explicitly disable `SGLANG_NVFP4_CKPT_FP8_NEXTN_MOE`; no engine patches, external draft, or draft-precision overrides.
- Download the unstaged checkpoint before SRT submission to `/data/home/sa-shared/gharunners/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`. Each launch resumes or validates the download. Failure stops submission.
- Scope `HF_HOME`, `HF_HUB_CACHE`, and `HF_XET_CACHE` to writable paths below that checkpoint for the download process only. This avoids the inherited container-only/read-only cache paths that blocked [the B300 download attempt](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36301487015).
- Forward the existing `--dsv4` client option through `srt_fixed_sequence.sh` to use the DeepSeek-V4 chat encoder. This is the same shared client change as #3516, included here so this PR can run independently.
- Sweep only the new B200 key, with default eval selection at c64/c128. No merge requested.

Upstream recipe reference: [SGLang DeepSeek-V4 configuration](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/8ca82118e0e1a0a1b49f85f675843b19ebb388ba/docs/src/snippets/configs/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.jsx). The sibling B300 recipe uses bundled EAGLE 3/1/4. This PR tests B200 TP2; memory fit, performance, and accuracy remain unverified until GPU CI passes.

Checkpoint metadata: [DeepSeek-V4-Flash config](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash/blob/main/config.json). The draft uses the checkpoint's bundled head and pinned upstream default loading, without draft quantization or draft KV overrides.

## Validation

- Matrix generation: eight TP2 8k1k points on `cluster:b200-nscale`, c1–128; c64/c128 selected for eval.
- 112 focused SRT tests pass with `RUNNER_NAME=local-validation`, including real launcher execution with stubbed external tools, download-cache isolation, model-path forwarding, abort-on-download-failure, native digest conversion, and cached-image precedence.
- The [first full-sweep-enabled run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36302441224) staged the checkpoint, then failed because Pyxis interpreted Docker's `repo:tag@sha256:...` as username credentials and received HTTP 400. The launcher now uses its existing Enroot conversion for this lane's uncached image, passing `repo:sha256:...` while preserving the original image identity/digest and valid squash-cache precedence. Serving settings are unchanged. Replacement GPU validation is pending.
- Ruff check and format, Bash syntax, and `git diff --check` pass.
- GPU sweep and evals pending.

## AI model disclosure

GPT 6 Astra Fast prepared the configuration, launcher/client changes, tests, PR, and CI monitoring. No delegated agents.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

新增 `dsv4flash-fp4-b200-sglang-mtp`，在 B200 Nscale 上使用原始 `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` checkpoint，运行 TP2、8192 输入 / 1024 输出 Token，并发为 1、2、4、8、16、32、64、128。

用户已确认沿用 [B300 PR #3516](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3516) 的原生 MTP 设置：`EAGLE`、3 steps、top-k 1、4 draft tokens，不是独立 EAGLE3 算法。沿用官方 SGLang CUDA 13 nightly `nightly-dev-cu13-20260925-8ca82118` 及 amd64 digest，权重和 KV 保留在 GPU，采用真实验证，保留 checkpoint 自带 draft head。显式关闭 `SGLANG_NVFP4_CKPT_FP8_NEXTN_MOE`，不修改引擎、不使用外部 draft、不覆盖 draft 精度。

SRT 提交前将未预置的 checkpoint 下载到 `/data/home/sa-shared/gharunners/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`，每次启动均续传或验证下载，失败时停止提交。仅下载进程将 `HF_HOME`、`HF_HUB_CACHE` 和 `HF_XET_CACHE` 指向该 checkpoint 下的可写路径，避免继承容器专用或只读缓存路径。服务进程的容器缓存设置不变。

共享固定序列客户端透传已有 `--dsv4` 参数，使用 DeepSeek-V4 chat 编码器。此修改与 #3516 相同，在本 PR 中保留以便独立运行。扫描仅覆盖新增 B200 配置，默认在 c64/c128 执行 eval，不请求合并。

验证：矩阵生成得到八个 TP2 8k1k 点；设置 `RUNNER_NAME=local-validation` 后 112 项针对性 SRT 测试通过，涵盖下载缓存隔离、模型路径传递、下载失败时停止提交、原生 digest 转换和缓存镜像优先级；Ruff、Bash 语法和 diff 检查通过。B200 TP2 的显存容量、性能与准确率仍待 GPU CI 验证。

</details>

- Keep weights and KV on GPU, with real speculative verification. No engine patches, external draft, CPU offloading, or simulated acceptance.
- Forward the existing `--dsv4` client option through `srt_fixed_sequence.sh`, using the shared DeepSeek-V4 chat encoder. This checkpoint has no HF chat template.

Upstream recipe reference: [DeepSeek-V4 B300 configuration](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/8ca82118e0e1a0a1b49f85f675843b19ebb388ba/docs/src/snippets/configs/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.jsx). Its original Flash recipe uses bundled EAGLE 3/1/4 at TP4; this PR tests TP2 and an 8k1k fixed-sequence workload. TP2 runtime performance and accuracy remain unverified until CI passes.

Checkpoint metadata: [DeepSeek-V4-Flash config](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash/blob/main/config.json). The target has FP4 experts, FP8 quantization metadata, and one bundled NextN layer. This PR does not override draft weights, draft quantization, or draft KV dtype.

## Validation

- Matrix generation: eight TP2 8k1k points, c1–128; c64 and c128 marked for eval.
- Upstream SRT schema validation: all variants pass.
- Native recipe selection: exactly one matching variant per point, two serving GPUs, EAGLE enabled, no simulated acceptance.
- Focused SRT tests: 111 passed with `RUNNER_NAME=local-validation`, including download-path forwarding and abort-on-download-failure through the real B300 launcher. Without that environment input, the existing H100 launcher fixture fails; no H100 code or test was changed.
- `ruff check infx`, `ruff format --check infx`, Bash syntax, and `git diff --check` pass.
- Initial canary failed before server launch because the recipe supplied AgentX-only `KV_OFFLOADING: none`, while fixed-sequence CI supplies an empty value. Removed that optional metadata; serving and GPU residency settings are unchanged. Revalidated all eight points using the actual fixed-sequence CI environment.
- The next canary passed recipe selection but failed because `/data/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` does not exist. The B300 launcher now runs `hf download --local-dir /data/home/sa-gha-runner/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` before SRT submission for this exact checkpoint. The official HF CLI resumes/validates on each launch, and download failure stops submission. SRT mounts the resulting local checkpoint. Other checkpoints retain their existing staging routes.
- The first host download attempt inherited container-only cache paths and failed with permission errors. The command now scopes `HF_HOME`, `HF_HUB_CACHE`, and `HF_XET_CACHE` to the writable runner-home cache without changing subsequent SRT container paths. Regression tests inject the failing inherited paths and verify both the downloader environment and preserved container mount.
- GPU sweep and evals: pending on the corrected head.

<details>

title: operatorx: gemm + moe on NVIDIA and AMD, measured in the serving framework's own layers
body:
OperatorX measures single ops (a GEMM, one MoE layer) on NVIDIA and AMD. It runs them through the same framework layers InferenceX serves with, so the kernel it times is the kernel real inference uses. This PR replaces the prototype under `experimental/operatorx/` with that version, adds the collection methodology, and connects the sweep to the OperatorX database.

## Scope
- **Ops: only `gemm` and `moe` for now.**
  - Attention, collectives, `moe_gemm`, `moe_forward`, `moe_layer`, the other NVIDIA backends, the TPU and Trainium runners, and the `scripts/inferencex_testlist` generator are removed. Ops and platforms will come back one at a time.
  - `gemm` (`ops/gemm.py`): activation `a` [M, K] and weight `b` [N, K]. Each is an operand descriptor `{"dtype", "scale"?, "scale2"?, "symmetric"?}`.
    - `scale` is `{"dtype", "static", "group": [rows, cols]}`, and `-1` spans a dimension.
    - So `[-1,-1]` is per-tensor, `[1,-1]` per-token, `[-1,1]` per-channel, `[1,g]` groups of g along K, and `[r,c]` 2-D blocks.
  - `moe` (`ops/moe.py`): one MoE layer from the router GEMM to the combined output. It has:
    - `tokens` and `hidden`;
    - `experts`: count, top-k, intermediate size, optional bias / latent / zero experts, and the operand descriptors `a1` (input), `w1` (fused gate/up weight), `w2` (down weight) and `a2` (intermediate activation), named after vLLM's `FusedMoEQuantConfig` slots;
    - `router`: gate dtype, scoring, selection, bias, renormalize, scale;
    - `activation`, optional `shared` experts, and a `routing` distribution (natural / balanced / zipf / single_hot).

    Kernels, dispatch, fusion and streams are the backend's choice.
  - **Every case says where it comes from:** `sources` lists one `<checkpoint>/<role>` per layer that runs it, e.g. `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro/attn.wq_b` or `zai-org/GLM-5-FP8/mlp`.
    - A shape shared by several models, or by several layers of one model, lists every pair, so each role stays tied to its model. The role is what follows the last `/`.
    - DeepSeek-V4 roles come from the checkpoints' own weight maps under vLLM's TP sharding and fusions. That covers the indexer, compressor, router, mHC and `head` (lm_head) shapes.
    - It's metadata and doesn't change what's measured.
- **Backends:**
  - `vllm` gemm (NVIDIA, AMD; `runners/common/vllm/linear.py`).
    - Builds vLLM's `ReplicatedLinear` under the quant config the descriptors imply, loads synthetic checkpoint-format weights, and runs `process_weights_after_loading`. vLLM then does its own activation quantization, repacking and kernel selection.
    - Emulation-only paths are reported unsupported. So is a quantized layer that comes out unquantized.
  - `vllm` moe (`runners/common/vllm/moe.py`): vLLM's `GateLinear` router, `FusedMoEFactory` experts and shared-expert MLP, wired as vLLM's model blocks wire them. Covers DeepSeek-V4 FP4 experts and hash routing, Kimi-K3 latent experts, Qwen's shared-expert gate, and forced expert loads.
  - `torch` (AMD): hipBLASLt bf16 and per-tensor fp8.
- **Testlists:**

  | Testlist | Cases | What |
  |---|---|---|
  | `gemm.json` | 5,416 | InferenceX matrix shapes under each checkpoint's per-layer quant scheme |
  | `gemm_serving_{8k1k,all}_min.json` | 1,505 / 8,099 | DeepSeek-V4-architecture shapes; `sources` is DSv4-Pro where the shape is one of its projections, else `[]` |
  | `gemm_perf.json` | 11 | BF16 smoke list |
  | `moe_small.json` | 62 | One full-size MoE layer per InferenceX MoE checkpoint scheme (32 checkpoints) at tokens=1; one layer per family swept at 8/64/512/2048 tokens; DeepSeek-R1 / Qwen3.5 FP8 under each expert-load distribution |

  gpt-oss is left out of `moe_small` for now. Its biased MXFP4 experts don't go through vLLM's mxfp4 method cleanly here yet.

## Measurement
- **GPU timing:**
  - Warmup has a wall-clock floor.
  - A GPU spin runs ahead of the timed loop, so launch overhead is excluded.
  - The cache is flushed before every iteration; the result is the median of 10.
- **Telemetry** (`runners/common/telemetry.py`):
  - NVML / amdsmi record clocks, power, temperatures and throttle reasons while each op runs.
  - Capped attempts are retried with growing inter-kernel sleeps.
- **Profiling** (`runners/common/profiling.py`, `runners/common/trace.py`):
  - A torch.profiler replay attaches a per-kernel breakdown (`metrics.profile`).
  - A platform-independent trace module (`trace.py`) with a small adapter per platform (CUDA/ROCm today).
- **Counters mode:** one marked replay per op under Nsight Compute or rocprofv3. Counter files go under `results/counters/`, and latencies are perturbed.

## CI (`operatorx-sweep.yml`)
- Inputs:
  - `runner`: a `cluster:` label (`cluster:h100-dgxc` default, then `h200-dgxc`, `b200-nscale`, `b300-dsxe`, `gb200-nv`, `gb300-nv`, `mi300x-amd`, `mi325x-amds`, `mi355x-amds`);
  - `backends`, `testlists`, `mode` (timing | counters), `world_sizes`, `chunk_size`.
- New last job `trigger-ingest`: sends InferenceX-app an `ingest-operatorx` repository_dispatch with the run id, as `run-sweep.yml` does for benchmark results. The app stores the run in the OperatorX database (SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app, branch `hbarclay/operatorx`). A run with failed shards is stored too; its unrun cases read as missing.
- Dispatched from `hbarclay/operatorx`:
  - `gemm` timing, 5,416 cases each: H200, B200, B300, MI300X, MI325X, MI355X.
  - `moe_small`: H200, B300, MI300X, MI325X, MI355X.
  - Counters mode: H200, B200, MI300X, MI325X, MI355X.
  - B300 counters needs Nsight Compute ≥ 2025.3 on the dsxe nodes.
  - MI355X `moe_small` reports a failure only because one shard is all-unsupported under `--strict`; its data is complete.
- `tests/test_ci.py` passes (32).

- Python lint/format, Bash syntax, YAML parsing, diff checks and the actual committed changelog/matrix validator passed. Actionlint passed after excluding its existing incompatibility with `$/` reusable-workflow paths.
- No new GPU tests were dispatched for this sync. GitHub checks on the pushed head are reported separately from local validation. No production TRT BFCL qualification or sweep-reuse claim is made.

## Remaining qualification

Representative GPU runs must still establish startup, completed evaluation, sample-level validity and performance for the native recipes. A startup failure has no accuracy score; the vendor tool-call/stop match rate is not BFCL accuracy, and a small smoke does not qualify a full suite. The stock TRT investigations remain separate experiments and do not change this branch's production BFCL guard.

## AI model disclosure

GPT-6 (Codex) performed this native migration, conflict resolution and local validation; the runtime did not expose a verifiable exact model variant/version. Earlier implementation and diagnostic work used Codex and delegated agents whose exact underlying model versions were not verified. No new agents were delegated for this sync.

## 概述

让 BFCL 使用原生推理 API，保留评估失败与来源信息，并移除 MiniMax 的运行时框架源码补丁。将本分支迁移到 main 的原生 SRT-Slurm 启动路径，保持所选 BFCL 请求和评分语义不变。**本 PR 仍为草稿：跨框架、offload 模式和并发的完整 GPU 验证尚未完成，正式 TRT BFCL 路径继续禁用。**

## 改动

- 区分 Chat Completions 与 Responses，保留固定版本的 BFCL 输入、所选用例清单、失败产物和上游评分逻辑。不改写请求，不伪造 token 用量。

- 通过原生配方保留本分支的 Kimi MI355X 正式配置，包括不使用草稿模型的 DCP8 配置，确保旧启动器删除后原有性能日志仍能选择有效配置。保留 main 更新后的 ROCm100 镜像，以及其余正式配置的退役处理。
- 完整保留已获取 main 的性能日志字节和本分支原有条目，仅在末尾追加原生迁移条目。

## 验证

- 使用锁定的 Python 环境，**2,079 项 CPU 测试通过，2 项跳过**。本地未安装可选的固定版本 BFCL 集成依赖；这些检查不代表真实 BFCL 或 GPU 评估通过。

title: [dnm]Add Kimi-K3 B300 Mooncake EFA recipes
body:
Adds six Kimi-K3 B300 Mooncake EFA AgentX recipes from #2814 on the current `srt-slurm` schema, pinned to `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-0961bbae2894d574be790d219651824eb199318e`.

The shared setup installs AWS EFA Installer 1.50.0, the Mooncake EFA wheel, and `libhwloc15` for NIXL's LIBFABRIC plugin. Disaggregated recipes select NIXL LIBFABRIC; aggregate recipes use Mooncake Store. FlashInfer autotuning is enabled.

Validation: all six recipes pass `srtctl dry-run`. The DSXE aggregate canary is in progress.

title: [Klaud Cold] Remove GLM-5 and DeepSeek-R1 SpeedBench collectors / [Klaud Cold] 移除 GLM-5 与 DeepSeek-R1 SpeedBench 采集脚本
body:
## Summary
Delete two SPEED-Bench AL collectors from `benchmarks/single_node/speedbench/`:
- `dsr1_fp4_b300_vllm.sh` (DeepSeek-R1)
- `glm5_fp4_b300_vllm.sh` (GLM-5)

Nothing references either script outside its own body. `speedbench-al.yml` picks the collector from the `model-prefix` input (`benchmarks/single_node/speedbench/${model-prefix}_fp4_b300_vllm.sh`), so after this `model-prefix=dsr1` / `glm5` will fail fast with a missing script.

`glm52_fp4_b300_vllm.sh` (GLM-5.2, kept) only pointed at the GLM-5 script in comments ("same serve parameters … as glm5_fp4_b300_vllm.sh"). `benchmarks/multi_node/srt-slurm-recipes/sglang/` was the only engine-first tree in the multi-node recipe directory. Every other recipe follows the layout in [RECIPES.md](benchmarks/multi_node/srt-slurm-recipes/RECIPES.md): `<model-prefix>/<engine>/<gpu>-<precision>/<workload>/<recipe>.yaml`. This moves its four MI355X SGLang disagg recipes into that layout and updates the 22 `CONFIG_FILE` lines in `configs/amd-master.yaml`. The `sglang/` directory is gone.

| Old | New |
|---|---|
| `sglang/dsr1/mi355x/fp4-disagg-fixed-seq.yaml` | `dsr1/sglang/mi355x-fp4/8k1k/disagg-variants.yaml` |
| `sglang/dsr1/mi355x/fp8-disagg-fixed-seq.yaml` | `dsr1/sglang/mi355x-fp8/8k1k/disagg-variants.yaml` |

The naming follows RECIPES.md:
- Workload is `8k1k`. All four recipes and all seven master-config entries run a single ISL 8192 / OSL 1024 point; `fixed-seq-len` is reserved for bundles spanning several lengths.
- The two DSR1 files are override bundles, so they are named `*-variants.yaml`.
- Filenames don't repeat model, hardware or precision already in the path.
- Role-qualified `p-tp4` / `d-tp8` is used for split TP.

File contents (including the internal `name:` fields) and every `override_*` selector are unchanged. All four moves are 100% renames.

Config keys touched (path only): `qwen3.5-fp8-mi355x-sglang-disagg`, `qwen3.5-fp4-mi355x-sglang-disagg`, `dsr1-fp8-mi355x-sglang-disagg`, `dsr1-fp8-mi355x-sglang-disagg-mtp`, `dsr1-fp4-mi355x-sglang-disagg`, `dsr1-fp4-mi355x-sglang-disagg-mtp`, `dsr1-fp4-mi355x-sglang-disagg-8k1k-mtp`.

The recipe path is part of the generated matrix row. `recipe_fingerprint` and `_matrix_curve_key` in `infx/matrix/plan.py` hash every field except `conc`, `exp-name` and `recipe-fingerprint`. So the 22 affected entries get new fingerprints. title: [Klaud Cold] Extract shared git/GitHub helpers into infx.git and infx.github packages
body:
## Summary

Audit all git and GitHub usage under `infx/` and refactor into two new shared subpackages:

- **`infx/git/`** -- subprocess-based git helpers (`show_file`, `rev_parse`, `diff_added_lines`, `ls_tree_batch_read`, `run_git`, `show_stage`) plus a `GitRepo` class wrapping GitPython for workflow automation
- **`infx/github/`** -- backward-compatible gh-CLI wrapper (moved from `infx/github.py`) plus `infx/github/client.py` with PyGithub helpers (`resolve_token`, `require_token`, `make_client`, `is_transient_error`, `retry_delay`)

All callers refactored to use shared helpers. Behavior is identical.

## Audit table

| File | Old usage | New helper |
|------|-----------|------------|
| `infx/github.py` | Module with gh-CLI `subprocess.run` | Converted to `infx/github/__init__.py` package (backward compat) |
| `infx/github/client.py` | N/A (new) | PyGithub helpers extracted from `merge_with_reuse.py` |
| `infx/git/repo.py` | N/A (new) | Subprocess helpers + `GitRepo` (from `GitOps`) |
| `infx/matrix/plan.py` | `subprocess.run(["git", "diff", ...])`, `subprocess.run(["git", "ls-tree", ...])`, `subprocess.run(["git", "cat-file", ...])` | `infx.git.diff_added_lines()`, `infx.git.ls_tree_batch_read()` |
| `infx/workflows/validate_perf_changelog.py` | `subprocess.run(["git", "show", ...])` | `infx.git.show_file()` |
| `infx/workflows/prepare_perf_changelog_merge.py` | `subprocess.run(["git", "show", ":stage:path"])` | `infx.git.show_stage()` |
| `infx/workflows/recover_failed_ingest.py` | `subprocess.run(["git", ...])` for show/rev-parse/worktree/add/diff/etc | `infx.git.run_git()`, `infx.git.show_file()`, `infx.git.rev_parse()` |
| `infx/workflows/merge_with_reuse.py` | Inline `GitOps` class, `_resolve_token()`, `_make_github()`, `_is_transient_error()`, `_retry_delay()` | `infx.git.repo.GitRepo`, `infx.github.client.*` |
| `infx/workflows/reuse.py` | `os.environ.get("GH_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN")` | `infx.github.client.require_token()` |
| `infx/workflows/reuse_comment.py` | Same inline token check | `infx.github.client.require_token()` |
| `infx/klaud/__main__.py` | `subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"])` | `infx.git.rev_parse()` |
| `infx/klaud/github.py` | `subprocess.check_output(["gh", "api", ...])` for binary zip download | Kept as subprocess (binary endpoint, not JSON) |

## Dependency decision

**GitPython and PyGithub remain in the `workflows` optional extra** (`pyproject.toml` unchanged). The `infx/git/` subprocess-based helpers (`show_file`, `rev_parse`, `diff_added_lines`, `ls_tree_batch_read`) work without GitPython and are safe for `--no-project` CI runs (used by `matrix/plan.py` and `validate_perf_changelog.py`). The `GitRepo` class and `infx/github/client.py` require their respective libraries and are importable only under the `workflows` extra. This avoids adding GitPython to the core install footprint while keeping a clean import boundary.

## Token safety

- Tokens are never passed on the command line, logged, printed, or embedded in URLs
- `resolve_token()` reads from env vars or `gh auth token` captured in memory only
- `require_token()` checks env vars only (no CLI fallback) for CI strictness
- PyGithub/GitPython/urllib3 debug logging suppressed at WARNING level
- Test added asserting tokens do not appear in error message text or repr

## Package shadowing

Python 3 absolute imports ensure `import git` resolves to GitPython and `import github` resolves to PyGithub even from within `infx/git/` and `infx/github/`. Tests verify this.

## Test plan

- [x] New tests in `infx/tests/git_tests/test_repo.py` (9 tests covering subprocess helpers, GitRepo, shadowing)
- [x] New tests in `infx/tests/github_tests/test_client.py` (12 tests covering token resolution, transient errors, retry delay, token safety, shadowing)
- [x] All existing tests pass: 1852 passed, 6 skipped (pre-existing skips)
- [x] Ruff check passes (all stable rules per `infx/ruff.toml`)
- [x] Ruff format check passes
- [x] 14 pre-existing `test_pool_launcher_*` failures on macOS (bash 3) are unrelated

## AI model disclosure

- Claude Opus 4.6 -- all code changes, audit, tests, and PR preparation

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 摘要

审计 `infx/` 下所有 git 和 GitHub 使用，重构为两个新共享子包：

- **`infx/git/`** -- 基于子进程的 git 助手 + 包装 GitPython 的 `GitRepo` 类
- **`infx/github/`** -- 向后兼容的 gh-CLI 包装器 + PyGithub 助手

所有调用方已重构使用共享助手。行为不变。

## 依赖决策

GitPython 和 PyGithub 保留在 `workflows` 可选依赖中。子进程助手无需 GitPython，适用于 `--no-project` CI 运行。

## 令牌安全

令牌不会在命令行、日志、打印或 URL 中泄露。已添加测试验证令牌不出现在错误信息中。

</details>

title: Refactor infx artifacts and clean up comments and tests / 重构 infx 工件逻辑并清理注释和测试
body:
## Description

Consolidate duplicated artifact logic in `infx` and remove tests and comments that obscure the behavior being maintained.

- Share topology normalization across fixed-sequence, AgentX, and eval artifact identities while preserving field order, defaults, and format-specific fields.
- Share Kimi/MiniMax compatibility envelopes, timestamped artifact paths, and JSON serialization while retaining verifier-specific scoring and failure handling.
- Replace source/inventory assertions and internal implementation mocks with controlled behavior tests. Merge orchestration now runs against real local Git repositories, including conflicts, rejected pushes, changed heads, and cleanup.
- Remove repetitive narration and decorative banners. Synchronize the English/Chinese architecture, testing, and client-limitation guides.

Benchmark settings, recipes, measured algorithms, and Pareto logic are unchanged, so no performance changelog entry was added. GPU benchmarks were not run; normal merge review and evidence requirements still apply.

## Validation

- Full CPU suite: **2,096 passed, 1 skipped** on Python 3.12.5 with Bash 5.2.37. The skipped test requires CUDA or ROCm.
- Ruff lint and formatting checks pass.
- [Linux CI](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36272590820) tests the final commit `8edbfbb6b07ad840ce66e73b274bd64ce8fbcf58`.

```bash
PATH="/tmp/infx-cleanup-tools/bin:$PATH" uv run --locked --all-extras --group test --no-editable \
  python -m pytest infx/tests/ utils/ runners/ experimental/CollectiveX/tests/ \
  experimental/operatorx/tests/ --ignore=utils/srt-slurm -n 4 -ra
uvx --exclude-newer PT12H ruff@latest check infx
uvx --exclude-newer PT12H ruff@latest format --check infx
```

Ten independent review agents checked behavior preservation, abstraction boundaries, test quality, comments, packaging, and documentation. Follow-ups removed remaining merge/matrix self-mocks, consolidated duplicate coverage, made the launcher fixture supply its runner name, and clarified the GPU-validation statement. The merge-test reviewer rechecked the replacement and found the reported issues resolved.

The [inline explanation](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3501#discussion_r4112826145) documents how the deleted multinode eval branch is preserved by `topology_key`.

## AI model disclosure

The runtime exposed only the GPT-6 family; the exact model/version could not be verified for the primary agent or the 13 delegated agents.

- Primary agent: integration, comment cleanup, documentation, validation, review follow-ups, and PR preparation.
- Three implementation agents: results refactor/tests, eval refactor/tests, and test-quality cleanup; also cross-reviewed changes.
- Ten independent review agents: vendor behavior, artifact identities, removed tests, new tests, comments, abstractions, integration/packaging, documentation/policy, full-diff correctness, and validation quality.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 改动说明

合并 `infx` 中重复的工件处理逻辑，并清理妨碍理解实际行为的测试和注释。

- 固定序列、AgentX 和评测工件的标识共享拓扑规范化逻辑，同时保留字段顺序、默认值和各格式专有字段。
- Kimi/MiniMax 共享兼容结果结构、带时间戳的工件路径和 JSON 序列化；各适配器继续负责自己的评分和失败处理。
- 用受控输入的行为测试替换源码/数据清单断言和内部实现 mock。合并流程现在使用真实的本地 Git 仓库，覆盖冲突、推送被拒、分支头变化和清理。
- 删除重复叙述和装饰性分隔注释，同步更新架构、测试和客户端限制的中英文文档。

基准测试设置、配方、被测算法和 Pareto 逻辑均未改变，因此未添加性能变更日志条目。尚未运行 GPU 基准测试；合并时仍需遵循常规审查和验证要求。

## 验证

- 在 Python 3.12.5 和 Bash 5.2.37 下运行完整 CPU 测试套件：**2,096 项通过，1 项跳过**。跳过项需要 CUDA 或 ROCm。
- Ruff lint 和格式检查通过。
- 上方 Linux CI 链接验证最终提交 `8edbfbb6b07ad840ce66e73b274bd64ce8fbcf58`，完整复现命令见上方代码块。

十个独立审查 agent 检查了行为保持、抽象边界、测试质量、注释、打包和文档。后续修改移除了剩余的合并/矩阵内部实现 mock，合并重复测试，为启动器测试显式提供 runner 名称，并澄清 GPU 验证说明。负责合并测试的审查 agent 已复查替代测试，确认所报告问题已解决。

上方行内说明解释了删除的多节点评测分支如何由 `topology_key` 保留。

## AI 模型使用说明

运行环境仅公开了 GPT-6 系列，无法核实主 agent 或 13 个委派 agent 的完整模型名称和版本。

- 主 agent：整合、注释清理、文档、验证、审查后续修改和 PR 准备。
- 三个实现 agent：结果处理重构及测试、评测重构及测试、测试质量清理，并交叉审查改动。
- 十个独立审查 agent：供应商评测行为、工件标识、删除的测试、新测试、注释、抽象设计、集成/打包、文档/规范、完整差异正确性和验证质量。

AgentX validation is a separate step with the same success/failure gate; diagnostic uploads still use `always()`. Eval validation remains after artifact upload, and multinode expected-concurrency selection is unchanged. Score thresholds now come from the workflow revision's packaged `infx/evals/thresholds.yaml`, as documented. Vendor runtime adapters already use the actual `infx/evals` files and remain standalone.

Refresh stale comments, test-fixture paths, and English/Chinese architecture, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation-plan references. Historical generator paths that intentionally access older Git revisions remain.

- 19 new behavioral cases pass. They execute the actual workflow validation commands with controlled artifacts and thresholds, a dependency-free Python environment, an unusable ambient `python3`, and either a package-less or hostile measured checkout.

- Both changed workflows parse; all 19 embedded Bash blocks pass syntax validation.

- Full local CPU regression suite: **2,120 passed, 1 skipped**, using `RUNNER_NAME=local-test` and the locked test environment. The final-head focused suite also passed all 19 cases.
- [Final-head PR CI passed](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36273091566) for `9bb2c53ed65216ee8369ae7dcc6de24c77eceb61`: **2,102 passed, 1 skipped**, plus clean lint. Earlier [post-relocation CI](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36272410248) passed 2,126 cases; the latest base includes the separate SRT-test removal in PR #3499. CI totals are reported separately from the local run above.
- No GPU benchmark or live vendor eval was dispatched. This cleanup does not alter recipes, serving settings, or performance parameters.

## Independent review

Two rounds of ten separate, read-only reviewers audited distinct scopes: migration completeness, historical execution, eval contracts, import security, AgentX failure gates, packaging/adapters, bilingual documentation, behavioral coverage, workflow lifecycle, and integration. The second round was newly spawned at the user's request and found no introduced blockers, including the dispatch-test relocation. Reference, documentation, and packaging reviewers also approved the final documentation move at `9bb2c53`.

Their findings were addressed: correct the documentation's “upload gate” wording, refresh stale paths, fix the new test's stdout/stderr assertion, and add missing-environment and concurrency-branch coverage. Both coverage and integration reviewers independently reran all 19 new cases and approved them. These agent reviews do not substitute for human CODEOWNER approval.

## AI model disclosure

Exact runtime model: `gpt_6_astra_fast` (GPT 6 Astra Fast).

- Parent agent: implementation, reference audit, tests, verification, and PR preparation.
- All twenty delegated reviewers across both rounds: the same verified runtime model, with the ten separate review roles listed above in each round. These were distinct agents and review perspectives, not different model families.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 变更

删除 `utils/` 下剩余的四个 Python 转发包装文件：AgentX 结果验证器，以及 Kimi、MiniMax 和评测分数验证器。删除两个已无用途的数据集和验证包标记。将 `utils/evals/test_run_eval_dispatch.py` 的行为覆盖迁移至 `infx/tests/evals/test_run_eval_dispatch.py`，修正仓库根目录计算；将 `utils/evals/EVALS.md` 原样迁移至 `infx/evals/EVALS.md` 并更新所有旧路径引用。`utils/evals/` 下不再保留已跟踪文件。其他行为测试、运行器配置脚本及 `aiperf`/`srt-slurm` 子模块保留。

基准测试工作流改为从现有的 `.result-tooling` 检出目录调用规范的评测和 AgentX 验证模块，使用预先准备的 Python 3.12，并将 `PYTHONPATH` 与 `-P` 限定在辅助子进程内。仅评测作业也会准备工具代码。工作目录仍为被测检出目录，因此不要求历史修订版包含 `infx`。

title: refactor: remove legacy result utility wrappers / 删除旧结果工具兼容入口
body:
## Description

Delete the five obsolete `utils/` wrappers and migrate their callers to the canonical modules:

| Removed entrypoint | Canonical module |
| --- | --- |
| `utils/result_filename.py` | `infx.results.result_filename` |
| `utils/validate_perf_changelog.py` | `infx.workflows.validate_perf_changelog` |
| `utils/process_changelog.py` | `infx.matrix.plan` |
| `utils/process_result.py` | `infx.results.fixed_sequence` |
| `utils/ci_priority.py` | `infx.workflows.ci_priority` |

Update workflow invocations, agent instructions, diagnostics, tests, and English/Chinese documentation. No retained repository caller uses these deleted paths.

Fixed-sequence processing uses a separate `.result-tooling` checkout at the workflow revision, scoped `PYTHONPATH`, `-P`, and Python 3.12. This lets result processing read historical measured-checkout artifacts without requiring the deleted wrappers or an `infx` package in that checkout. Multinode processing uses the canonical batch processor.

Recovery uses its own planner module with an explicit `INFERENCEX_REPOSITORY_ROOT` pointing at the selected worktree. This preserves historical recipe node counts without importing the measured worktree's Python package. Historical generator subprocesses override that setting with their own snapshot root rather than inheriting the recovery worktree.

title: [Klaud Cold] Port merge_with_reuse.sh to infx.workflows.merge_with_reuse / 将 merge_with_reuse.sh 移植到 infx.workflows.merge_with_reuse
body:
## Summary

Replace all raw `subprocess.run(["gh", ...])` and `subprocess.run(["git", ...])` calls in `infx/workflows/merge_with_reuse.py` with **PyGithub** (GitHub REST API) and **GitPython** (git operations). Behavior is identical to the prior module: same eligibility checks, comment text, sync/merge order, perf-changelog conflict resolution, head-lag retry, exit codes 0/1/2, and error messages.

## Dependencies

Added to the `workflows` optional extra in `pyproject.toml`:
- `PyGithub>=2.6,<3` (locked 2.10.0)
- `GitPython>=3.1,<4` (locked 3.1.62)

Install: `uv sync --extra workflows` or `uv run --extra workflows python -m infx.workflows.merge_with_reuse <pr>`

## `gh` to PyGithub mapping

| Old `gh` / `infx.github.api()` call | New PyGithub call |
|---|---|
| `gh pr view --json headRefName,isCrossRepository,state,labels` | `Repository.get_pull()` fields: `.state`, `.head.repo.full_name`, `.head.ref`, `.labels` |
| `gh pr comment --body` | `PullRequest.create_issue_comment()` |
| `gh pr view --json headRefOid` | `pull.update(); pull.head.sha` |
| `gh pr view --json mergeCommit` | `merge_status.sha` from merge result |
| `gh pr checks --watch --fail-fast` | Poll `commit.get_check_runs()` + `commit.get_combined_status()` with fail-fast semantics |
| `gh pr merge --squash --admin` | `PullRequest.merge(merge_method="squash", sha=<head>)` -- admin bypass relies on token's ruleset bypass permission; API error surfaced verbatim |
| `infx.github.api("/commits/{sha}/check-runs")` | `gh_repo.get_commit(sha).get_check_runs()` |
| `gh api` (in `sweep_runs.py` via `infx.github`) | Unchanged -- `find_eligible_run` still calls `infx.github.paginate()` for artifact/run listing |

## `git` to GitPython mapping

| Old `subprocess.run(["git", ...])` | New `GitOps` method |
|---|---|
| `git status --porcelain` | `repo.is_dirty(untracked_files=True)` |
| `git symbolic-ref --short HEAD` / `git rev-parse HEAD` | `repo.active_branch.name` / `repo.head.commit.hexsha` |
| `git rev-parse <ref>` | `repo.rev_parse(ref).hexsha` |
| `git fetch origin ...` | `repo.git.fetch(...)` |
| `git checkout ...` | `repo.git.checkout(...)` |
| `git merge origin/main --no-ff --no-edit` | `repo.git.merge(...)` with return code |
| `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` | `repo.git.diff("--name-only", "--diff-filter=U")` |
| `git diff --quiet -- <path>` | `repo.git.diff("--quiet", ...)` (exception = non-zero) |
| `git show :<stage>:<path>` | `repo.git.show(..., stdout_as_string=False, strip_newline_in_stdout=False)` -- byte-identical to `git show` |
| `git add / commit / push` | `repo.git.add/commit/push(...)` |
| `git branch -D / merge --abort` | Wrapped in `contextlib.suppress(GitCommandError)` |

The `GitOps` class is a thin wrapper so tests can inject a mock or a temporary-directory `Repo`.

## Auth fallback

Token resolution: `GH_TOKEN` env > `GITHUB_TOKEN` env > `gh auth token` (one bootstrap subprocess, read from stdout only). Respects `GITHUB_API_URL` for GHE. Token is never printed, logged, passed as a CLI argument, or embedded in remote URLs. PyGithub/GitPython/urllib3 debug logging forced to WARNING.

## Review fixes

All findings from the code review have been addressed:

| # | Finding | Fix | Test |
|---|---------|-----|------|
| 1 | **BLOCKER**: `show_stage()` strips trailing newline, breaking `parse_changelog` | Use `stdout_as_string=False` + `strip_newline_in_stdout=False` for byte-exact output | `TestChangelogConflictIntegration::test_resolve_real_conflict_preserves_main_bytes` (real git repo with genuine conflict) + `TestShowStageRawBytes` (2 tests) |
| 2 | **BLOCKER**: `wait_for_checks` counts superseded re-runs; treats `cancelled` as failure | Dedupe by name (latest `started_at`/`id` wins); `cancelled` is NOT fail-fast; `stale` treated as pending; `skipped`/`neutral` pass | `test_rerun_duplicate_old_cancelled_new_success`, `test_rerun_duplicate_old_failed_new_success`, `test_stale_keeps_waiting`, `test_genuine_failure_fail_fast`, `test_no_checks_yet_keeps_waiting`, `test_cancelled_not_fail_fast` |
| 3 | Merge not pinned to verified SHA | Pass `sha=post_merge` to `PullRequest.merge()` | `test_merge_calls_squash_with_sha` |
| 4 | Transient API errors abort polling | Retry 5xx/429/403/connection errors with logged backoff until timeout | `TestWaitForChecks::test_transient_error_retried_then_succeeds`, `TestWaitForCheck::test_transient_error_retried_then_succeeds` |
| 5 | Temp branch leak: cleanup closes over stale `local_branch=""` | `_MergeState` shared object lets cleanup see the real branch name | `TestBranchCleanup::test_branch_deleted_after_success`, `test_branch_deleted_after_failure` (real git repos) |
| 6 | Cleanup skips `merge --abort`, leaving half-merged tree | `cleanup()` runs `merge_abort()` before `checkout` | `TestMergeAbortInCleanup::test_merge_abort_on_exception_during_conflict` (real git repo with genuine conflict) |
| 7 | Deleted fork: `pull.head.repo` can be `None` -> `AttributeError` | Check for `None` with clear error message | `test_deleted_fork_exits_one`, `test_deleted_fork_error_message` |
| 8 | No friendly error when `workflows` extra missing | Guard imports; `main()` exits 1 with install hint | `test_missing_workflows_extra_exits_one` |
| -- | Non-changelog conflict aborts | `merge_abort()` called, exit 1 | `test_non_changelog_conflict_aborts` |
| -- | Canonicalize amend path | `--amend` when changelog changes after merge | `test_canonicalize_amend_path` |
| -- | Synchronize empty commit | `--allow-empty` when `pre_merge == post_merge` | `test_synchronize_empty_commit` |
| -- | `main()` propagates merge failure | Returns non-zero from `merge_pr` | `test_main_propagates_merge_failure` |
| -- | Merge comment updated | Documents MergePullRequestInput has no bypass field; admin bypass via ruleset | (code comment update) |

## Tests

77 tests (up from 47):
- **Auth**: GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, `gh auth token` fallback, failure-returns-empty
- **Token safety**: 3 tests asserting token never appears in stdout/stderr
- **Eligibility**: dirty worktree, closed PR, fork, deleted fork, multiple sweep labels, incompatible labels, no eligible run
- **Comment posting**: correct run ID
- **Full flow**: clean merge, head-lag retry, head changed, squash merge with SHA pin, check-changelog failure, API error surfacing, non-changelog conflict abort, canonicalize amend path, synchronize empty commit
- **Check polling**: `wait_for_check` (success, failure, timeout, transient error retry), `wait_for_checks` (all pass, fail-fast, status error, timeout, re-run dedup, stale, no checks, cancelled, transient error retry)
- **Deduplication**: `_latest_check_runs` (newest wins, different names kept), `_latest_statuses`
- **Transient errors**: `_is_transient_error` (500, 429, 404, connection, timeout, value), `_retry_delay` (Retry-After, default, cap)
- **Integration (real git repos)**: show_stage raw bytes (2 tests), changelog conflict resolution, branch cleanup (success + failure), merge abort in cleanup
- **_poll_pr_head**: immediate match, retry success, retry exhaustion
- **CLI**: usage (no args, non-numeric, extra args), missing workflows extra, propagates merge failure
- **Exit codes**: main returns 2 on bad usage, die returns 1
- **_MergeState**: initial state, settable

All pass in ~2s. Full suite: 1915 passed, 14 failed (known macOS bash 3 `mapfile` failures), 6 skipped.

## Docs updated

All invocations changed from `python3 -m infx.workflows.merge_with_reuse` to `uv run --extra workflows python -m infx.workflows.merge_with_reuse`:
- `.claude/commands/merge-prs.md`
- `.github/AGENT_OPERATIONS.md`
- `.github/codeowner-signoff-verify-prompt.md`
- `.github/workflows/README.md`
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CONTRIBUTING_zh.md`
- `docs/KLAUD_DEBUG.md`
- `docs/ci-procedures.md`, `docs/ci-procedures_zh.md`

**Stayed in `utils/`** (their subject is not in `infx/`): `test_amd_sglang_cli.py` (benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils), `test_inject_srt_power_concurrencies.py` (runners/), `test_srt_fixed_sequence.py` (benchmarks shell), `changelog_gate_tests/test_merge_with_reuse.py` (utils/merge_with_reuse.sh), `agentic/aggregation/test_power_lifecycle.py` and `evals/test_run_eval_dispatch.py` (benchmarks/benchmark_lib.sh).

## Non-mechanical fixes
- Repo-root depth (`Path(__file__).parents[N]`) adjusted for every moved file; `test_generate_sweep_configs.py` now locates the kept `utils/matrix_logic/generate_sweep_configs.py` shim by absolute path.
- `test_collect_eval_results.py` imports `infx.evals.{kimi_vendor_eval,minimax_provider_eval}` instead of the bare `evals.*` shim modules; four eval tests drop their now-pointless `sys.path.insert(utils/evals)`.

- CI (`ci.yml`) now runs `python -m pytest infx/tests/ utils/ runners/ ...`; `docs/testing*.md` and `docs/configuration-procedures*.md` point at the new paths.

title: [Klaud Cold] Migrate SPEED-Bench AL collectors to native srt-slurm
body:
## Summary

Migrate 6 SPEED-Bench acceptance-length (AL) collectors from legacy bash-script execution to the native srt-slurm single-node path:

- **Migrated models**: dsr1, dsv4, glm5, glm52, qwen3.5, qwen3.8next (all `*_fp4_b300_vllm.sh`)
- **Legacy models** (unchanged): dsv4dspark, dsv4dsparkprob, kimik3 (both variants), minimaxm3

### Changes

- **6 srt-slurm recipe YAMLs** (`benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/<model>/vllm/b300-fp4-speedbench/speedbench.yaml`): per-model recipes with `zip_override` groups for thinking modes x MTP 1-8
- **Shared client** (`benchmarks/single_node/srt_speedbench.sh`): one script handles all migrated models (per-mode sampling, chat-template kwargs shim, metrics collection, AL computation)
- **Python collector support** (`infx/srt_slurm/single_node.py`): `_is_speedbench()` detection; `validate_recipe()` skips ISL/OSL/RANDOM_RANGE_RATIO/USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE checks for collectors; `runtime_arguments()` binds CATEGORY, SPEEDBENCH_OUTPUT_LEN, CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS_ON
- **Aggregation module** (`infx/workflows/speedbench_matrix.py`): reads per-cell result JSONs and produces golden YAML matrix output
- **Workflow routing** (`.github/workflows/speedbench-al.yml`): conditional case statement routes migrated prefixes through srt-slurm (one submission per cell), keeps draft-model collectors on legacy `BENCH_SCRIPT_OVERRIDE`. `qwen3.8next` binds TP/GPU_COUNT=4 to match its TP4 recipe (plain TP8 is incompatible with its FP8 checkpoint's 128-wide quantization blocks — the legacy collector silently folded TP=8 to 4 the same way)
- **Delete 6 legacy scripts** (`benchmarks/single_node/speedbench/{dsr1,dsv4,glm5,glm52,qwen3.5,qwen3.8next}_fp4_b300_vllm.sh`)
- **Tests**: 7 new collector tests in `utils/test_srt_single_node.py`, 4 matrix aggregation tests in `utils/test_speedbench_matrix.py`

## Test plan

- [x] All 11 new tests pass locally (7 collector + 4 matrix)
- [x] All 40 non-`test_pool_launcher` tests pass (pool launcher tests fail pre-existing on macOS bash 3.2 due to `mapfile`)
- [x] Workflow YAML parses cleanly; `zizmor` clean; `ruff check`/`format --check infx` clean
- [x] First GPU run [36227842725](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36227842725) failed before any server started: srtctl rejected every cell with `benchmark.env.THINKING: Not a valid string` — it expands zip variants with ruamel (YAML 1.2) and reloads them with a YAML 1.1 loader, where bare `on`/`off` become booleans. Fixed by storing `thinking_on`/`thinking_off` (client strips the prefix) plus a regression test that runs srtctl's own variant round trip for every cell.
- [x] GPU run 36228786727 on `a43d14df`: THINKING now validates; both cells then died with `vllm: error: unrecognized arguments: --device-ids` — vLLM v0.21.0 predates the flag srtctl passes by default. Fixed by `engine.set_visible_devices: true` in all six recipes (+ regression test).
- `13afd0d2`: recipes now use one `zip_override_mtp` group that varies only `speculative-config`; the workflow binds `THINKING` / `MTP` per cell as runtime env overrides.
- [x] GPU run 36258721401 on `13afd0d2`: the runtime `--set benchmark.env.THINKING="off"` hit the same YAML 1.1 bool round trip. `runtime_arguments` now binds `thinking_on` / `thinking_off` (`50f9a780`, with a test that pushes the real `--set` args through srtctl's override + dump + reload).
- [x] GPU run 36259122024 on `50f9a780`: THINKING and `--device-ids` fixes held; the server came up and ran ~18 min per cell, then the client died sourcing `/infmax-workspace/benchmarks/benchmarks/benchmark_lib.sh` (workspace fallback went up one level from `benchmarks/single_node/`). Fixed in `df1dff97` with a test that runs the client without the legacy `/workspace`.
- [x] GPU run 36259122024 on `50f9a780`: server came up; client sourced `/infmax-workspace/benchmarks/benchmarks/benchmark_lib.sh` (fallback went up one level). Fixed in `df1dff97` with a regression test.
- [x] **GPU verification green** on `df1dff97`: [run 36261519246](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/36261519246) — both srt-slurm cells produced AL. `speedbench-reference-al-dsv4`:
  ```yaml
  deepseek-v4-pro:
    thinking_off:
      1: 1.93
      2: 2.60
  ```
  Matches the committed legacy-bash curve `infx/golden_al_distribution/dsv4_mtp.yaml` (thinking_off 1: 1.92, 2: 2.61) within 0.01.

**Not merging yet** — GPU verification is green; awaiting review.

title: perf(amd): enable MiniMax-M3 ATOM FlyDSL decode / 启用 MiniMax-M3 ATOM FlyDSL 解码
body:
## Summary

Enable the MiniMax-M3 paged-decode optimization from [ROCm/ATOM#2366](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/pull/2366) in the existing MI355X AgentX recipe, following #3189 and the [upstream recipe](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/blob/94cde4ba786f45b38c26ee8201444659e44f861f/recipes/MiniMax-M3-Agentic-InferenceX.md).

- Update `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609171455` to `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609231248`. Enable `ATOM_PA_FLYDSL=1` and `ATOM_PA_FLYDSL_PLAN=1`; changing the image alone would leave FlyDSL disabled.
- Fix GPU visibility: when ROCR supplies physical GPU IDs, clear HIP's second mask. Automatically selected offload GPUs use ROCR alone (`0,4` for TP2; `0,1,4,5` for TP4). Preserve caller-supplied ROCR and HIP-only allocations.
- Retain all 19 throughput points, 3600-second profiles, EAGLE3 K3, golden AL 2.78, indexer CP, graph sizes, and existing LMCache budgets. Eval keeps real draft acceptance. The existing `Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA` draft and precision settings are unchanged; no engine patches are applied.

Registry manifest: `sha256:80f2c66579704aba933a9ff2a6e22e1dc61917c0fe6a2b0a0166816cd6d0100a`. Image labels identify ATOM `0.1.7.dev16+g10ab5e8c1`, source revision `10ab5e8c1995c3e8d9e0674534f093d1e33a04ff`, and ROCm 7.2.4. That ATOM revision contains #2366. Actual kernel routing and performance remain to be verified in GPU CI.

## CI scope

One PR sweep contains **all 19 throughput jobs and exactly one eval job**: TP4 C48 with LMCache offload, using `minimax-vendor` / `minimax_m3_full` (102 provider cases) and real draft acceptance.

The changelog sets `eval-concs: [48]`. The planner filters only already-selected eval concurrencies, leaves throughput intact, and rejects a selection with no matching evals. The field also narrows multi-node all-concurrency eval rows and is incompatible with `no-evals` / `append-only`.

**Combined GPU CI started:** [Run Sweep #35873197630](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35873197630), on commit `7bbb0ec775dd86b8f6ebb3c4e345cdfe283b1c1a`, includes throughput and the single eval in one workflow. The two previous separate runs were cancelled.

## Validation

- Bash syntax, YAML parsing, `git diff --check`, and the real changelog validator passed; historical changelog bytes are preserved.
- The real changelog planner emits 19 AgentX throughput jobs and exactly one TP4 C48 offload eval in the same plan; other eval buckets are empty.
- 450 focused changelog, matrix, and validation tests passed, including eval filtering, unchanged throughput, multi-node selection, invalid inputs, and incompatible modifiers. Ruff lint and format checks passed for all `infx/` Python files.
- Ran the real script and shared replay builder with external GPU, network, installation, and workload operations stubbed: inherited ROCR/HIP masks, automatic TP2 and TP4 offload placement, explicit ROCR placement, and HIP-only placement passed. Verified FlyDSL/planner enablement, per-rank memory/lookup workers, TP-specific indexer CP, real-acceptance eval, and chat-template replay.
- GPU throughput and eval results are pending. No new measured performance claims are made.

## AI model disclosure

Prepared with OpenAI GPT-6 via Codex for implementation, source inspection, and local validation. The exact runtime model/version identifier was not exposed and could not be verified. No delegated agents were used.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 概要

参考 #3189 和 [ATOM 上游配方](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/blob/94cde4ba786f45b38c26ee8201444659e44f861f/recipes/MiniMax-M3-Agentic-InferenceX.md)，将 [ROCm/ATOM#2366](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/pull/2366) 的 MiniMax-M3 paged-decode 优化接入现有 MI355X AgentX 配置。

- 保留全部 19 个吞吐点、3600 秒测量时长、EAGLE3 K3、golden AL 2.78、indexer CP、图捕获尺寸和现有 LMCache 预算。eval 使用真实 acceptance；现有 `Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA` draft 及精度设置保持不变，不修改 engine。

Registry manifest 为 `sha256:80f2c66579704aba933a9ff2a6e22e1dc61917c0fe6a2b0a0166816cd6d0100a`。镜像标签记录 ATOM `0.1.7.dev16+g10ab5e8c1`、源码 revision `10ab5e8c1995c3e8d9e0674534f093d1e33a04ff` 和 ROCm 7.2.4，该 ATOM revision 已包含 #2366。实际 kernel 路由和性能仍待 GPU CI 确认。

**同一次 PR sweep 包含全部 19 个吞吐 job 和唯一一个 eval job**：TP4 C48、LMCache offload，使用 `minimax-vendor` / `minimax_m3_full`（102 个 provider case）和真实 draft acceptance。

changelog 设置 `eval-concs: [48]`。planner 只过滤常规策略已选中的 eval 并发，保留全部吞吐点；没有匹配 eval 时拒绝生成。该字段也支持缩减多节点的全并发 eval 行，不能与 `no-evals` / `append-only` 同时使用。

**合并后的 GPU CI 已启动：** [Run Sweep #35873197630](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35873197630)，运行提交为 `7bbb0ec775dd86b8f6ebb3c4e345cdfe283b1c1a`，在同一条工作流中包含吞吐和唯一的 eval。此前两条分开的运行已取消。

- 正式 changelog planner 在同一份 plan 中生成 19 个 AgentX 吞吐 job 和唯一一个 TP4 C48 offload eval，其他 eval bucket 均为空。
- 450 项 changelog、矩阵和校验测试通过，覆盖 eval 过滤、保留吞吐、多节点选择、非法输入及冲突选项；全部 `infx/` Python 文件通过 Ruff lint 和格式检查。

title: fix(ci): include AgentX in PR canary selection / 修复 PR 扫描中 AgentX 的 Canary 选择
body:
## Description

AgentX-only PR sweeps skip the canary because selection considers only fixed-sequence rows. A skipped canary lets the full matrix start immediately, as in [#3454](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3454). Multi-node AgentX has no canary path either.

Select one single-node throughput canary when available, including AgentX; otherwise select one multi-node AgentX throughput row. Run it through the matching workflow and remove it from the later matrix. Eval rows remain excluded. Against #3454's generated matrix, the selector picks one c1 canary and leaves 27 throughput rows. A multi-node-only matrix selects one row and holds the rest until it succeeds.

## AI model disclosure

- Model/version: OpenAI GPT-6; the exact runtime model identifier could not be verified.
- Role: prepared the workflow change, documentation, and local checks.

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix
- [x] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [x] I have completed the AI model disclosure and kept it current
- [x] I have tested my changes locally
- [x] I have updated documentation if necessary

<summary>中文</summary>

仅包含 AgentX 任务的 PR 扫描会跳过 Canary，因为选择逻辑只检查固定序列任务。Canary 被跳过后，完整矩阵立即启动；[#3454](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3454) 就出现了这一情况。多节点 AgentX 也没有 Canary 路径。

本次修改优先选择一个单节点吞吐量任务作为 Canary，包括 AgentX；若没有合格任务，则选择一个多节点 AgentX 吞吐量任务。它通过对应的工作流运行，并从后续矩阵移除。Eval 任务仍不参与选择。使用 #3454 实际生成的矩阵检查时，逻辑选出一个并发数为 1 的 Canary，剩余 27 个吞吐量任务。仅有多节点任务时，逻辑选择一项，并等待其成功后才启动其余任务。

AI 模型披露：OpenAI GPT-6 负责工作流修改、文档和本地检查；运行环境未提供可核实的完整模型标识。

## Summary

Remove 20 unreferenced srt-slurm recipe YAMLs, totaling 2,632 deleted lines:

| Scope | Files |

| MiniMax-M3 / vLLM / MI355X FP4 MTP / AgentX | 1 |

No master config, launcher, dependency pin, retained recipe, or historical changelog is changed. This is a deletion-only cleanup against `8ec35e0e97c9f0846a132a4eb891b51e87d5e8b9`, not a benchmark migration or model retirement.

## Audit boundaries

- Audited all 765 YAMLs in the single-node and multi-node srt-slurm recipe trees, including four shared EPLB assets.
- None of the deleted recipe-relative paths occurs in any other tracked text file outside historical `perf-changelog.yaml`. Checked active and deprecated master configs, launchers, workflows, scripts, tests, docs, and other recipes. Single-node selection uses explicit `srt-recipe`; multi-node selection uses `CONFIG_FILE`.
- Retained all 413 recipes referenced by active configs, all 328 referenced only by deprecated configs, and the four shared load-balancer YAMLs used through recipe bind mounts.
- Compared complete parsed YAML against the pinned NVIDIA/srt-slurm checkout (`8dace5f9596907a5075bf056251563b2e9563e7d`) and NVIDIA/srt-slurm-recipes (`2018b1dda0a2792edcb81fe7bae5293d25fd4ab2`). Found no exact parsed-content duplicates to remove. The pinned runtime does not ship a historical `recipes/` tree, and InferenceX stages its local recipes explicitly; an upstream recipe with similar settings is not a safe drop-in replacement.
- This PR does not overlap the recipe-selector/tooling work in #3390 or consolidation work in #3391, and does not delete `configs/deprecated` as proposed in #3463.

## Validation

- `git diff --check`: passed.
- All 413 unique active master-config recipe paths resolve. Deletion adds zero missing paths to active or deprecated configs. The deprecated NVIDIA config already has 398 missing legacy paths; those are unchanged.
- Ran the real `generate_config_matrix` implementation for each of 199 active config keys before and after deletion in both default and all-eval modes. Outputs are byte-identical, including errors:
  - 197 successful configs: 1,713 default rows and 1,652 all-eval rows.
  - Two pre-existing failures: `qwen3.5-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-power-ab` and `qwen3.5-fp8-b300-sglang-agentic-power-ab` reference `cluster:b300-nv`, whose `available-cpu-dram-mib` metadata is absent. An unfiltered full-sweep fails for this same reason before any edits.
- Local matrix and SRT unit tests: **447 passed, 1 failed**:

  ```bash
  python -m pytest utils/matrix_logic/ utils/test_srt_single_node.py \
    utils/test_synthetic_acceptance.py utils/test_srt_cluster_config.py -q --tb=short
  ```

  The failure is `test_pool_launcher_stages_artifacts_and_propagates_failure[h100-dgxc-slurm-none]`: its environment lacks `RUNNER_NAME`. Reproduced the same failure in a clean worktree of the base commit. No test/source changes are included to conceal it.
- No GPU sweep or runtime-performance claim. No performance changelog entry: only unreferenced files are removed; no executed recipe or generated matrix changes.

## AI model disclosure

GPT 6 Astra, via Perplexity Computer: repository audit, deletion selection, implementation, validation, and PR preparation. No delegated agents or additional models.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 概述

删除 20 个未被引用的 srt-slurm 配方 YAML，共减少 2,632 行：

- Kimi-K2.5 / TRT-LLM / B200 FP4 / 8k1k：11 个。
- MiniMax-M3 / vLLM / GB200 FP4 / AgentX：6 个。
- Qwen3.5 / SGLang / GB200 FP4 / AgentX：1 个。
- Kimi-K3 和 MiniMax-M3 / vLLM / MI355X FP4 MTP / AgentX：各 1 个。

本 PR 基于 `8ec35e0e97c9f0846a132a4eb891b51e87d5e8b9`，仅删除未引用文件，不修改主配置、启动器、依赖版本、保留配方或历史性能变更日志，不迁移基准测试，也不退役模型。

## 审计范围

检查了单节点和多节点目录中的全部 765 个 YAML，包括 4 个共享 EPLB 文件。除历史 `perf-changelog.yaml` 外，其他受版本控制的文本文件均未引用这些待删除配方的相对路径；检查覆盖活动及已弃用配置、启动器、工作流、脚本、测试、文档和其他配方。单节点通过显式 `srt-recipe` 选择配方，多节点使用 `CONFIG_FILE`。

保留活动配置引用的 413 个配方、仅已弃用配置引用的 328 个配方，以及被其他配方挂载使用的 4 个负载均衡 YAML。与 NVIDIA/srt-slurm 固定版本 `8dace5f9596907a5075bf056251563b2e9563e7d` 和 NVIDIA/srt-slurm-recipes 的 `2018b1dda0a2792edcb81fe7bae5293d25fd4ab2` 比较后，未发现解析内容完全相同的配方。当前固定运行时不包含历史 `recipes/` 目录，不能因为上游存在相似配方就删除仍被引用的本地文件。

本 PR 不涉及 #3390 的选择器工具或 #3391 的配方合并，也不执行 #3463 提出的 `configs/deprecated` 删除。

title: [Klaud Cold] Remove pointers to the deleted single-node bash folders; delete configs/deprecated and amd_utils/deprecated
body:
## Summary
Follow-up to #3461 and #3464, which deleted `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/` and `benchmarks/single_node/fixed_seq_len/`: remove everything that still pointed at them, and delete `configs/deprecated/` and `benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/deprecated/`. Rebased on `main` after #3464.

### 1. DSv4.1 Flash H100/H200 SGLang AgentX: drop the block32 tilings
The single-node recipes `dsv41flash/sglang/h{1,2}00-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml` ran `setup_script: dsv41flash-h{1,2}00-block32.sh`, which loaded the block32 installers and `kernel_configs/` from the deleted folder (broken on `main` since #3461). The tilings are not re-added: this deletes both setup scripts, drops the recipes' `setup_script` entries and the H200 recipe's 16 `DSV41_BLOCK32_TP` env vars. Both recipes now run with SGLang's default kernel tilings (tiling only; checkpoint data, scales and dtypes were never changed by the setup script).

### 2. Remove the 17 bash-only AgentX search-space entries
Every single-node `agentic-coding` entry without `srt-recipe:` ran a deleted script. Removed:

| Config key | Change |
|---|---|
| `qwen3.5-fp8-b300-sglang-agentic-power-ab` | deleted (all 2 entries bash) |
| `qwen3.5-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-power-ab` | deleted (all 2 entries bash) |
| `qwen3.8next-fp8-h100-sglang-agentic-mtp` | deleted (1/1 bash) |
| `kimik3-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-mtp` | deleted (3/3 bash) |
| `minimaxm3-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-mtp` | deleted (2/2 bash) |
| `dsv41flash-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-dspark` | deleted (2/2 bash) |
| `kimik3-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-mtp` | dropped the 2 DCP8 LMCache arms (conc 14/16/48, 56/72); TP8 GPU-resident srt arm kept |
| `minimaxm3-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-mtp` | dropped the 2 LMCache arms; TP4/TP2 GPU-resident srt arms kept |
| `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-mtp` | dropped the DCP4 LMCache arm; TP4/TP8 GPU-resident srt arms kept |

The ATOM LMCache arms can't move to srt-slurm yet (srtctl reserves ATOM's `kv-transfer-config` for disaggregated workers); the recipe header comments now say they were removed. `srt-slurm-recipes/kimik3/vllm/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml` is kept (it points nowhere legacy) and could revive the Kimi-K3 vLLM config.

### 3. Launchers
- `launch_gb200-nv.sh` / `launch_gb300-nv.sh`: remove the dead `dsv41flash` bash branch (the `SRT_RECIPE` branch above it already exits for every single-node AgentX point).
- `launch_mi355x-amds.sh`: remove the `minimaxm3_fp4_mi355x_atom_mtp.sh` special case.

### 4. Docs and comments
`MODELS(_zh).md` scenario table, `docs/index(_zh).md`, `docs/DOCUMENTATION_PLAN(_zh).md`, the codeowner verify prompt's applicability rule, `KLAUD_DEBUG.md`, and two code comments now point at the srt-slurm recipes / `benchmarks/srt_agentic.sh` or note the removal.

Intentionally left: `docs/waiver/2508.md` (historical waiver record), dated history (MODELS deprecation note for #2493, `perf-changelog.yaml`), the SHA-pinned PR #3205 example in the codeowner prompt, and the `fixture_*.sh` strings in `utils/test_srt_single_node.py` that exercise the generic launcher fallback.

### 5. Delete `configs/deprecated/` and move the docs to the srt-slurm flow
#3464 merged with only its first commit (the `fixed_seq_len/` deletion); its follow-up is carried here:
- Delete `configs/deprecated/{amd,nvidia}-master.yaml` (nothing reads them). `AGENTS.md` "Deprecating benchmark configs", `docs/configuration-procedures(_zh).md` and the Claude review prompt in `.github/workflows/claude.yml` now say retired entries are deleted, with git history and `perf-changelog.yaml` as the record.
- Rewrite `.claude/commands/add-model-hardware.md` (the add-model-hardware skill) and the configuration-procedures new-config steps for srt-slurm recipes: no bash script under `fixed_seq_len/`, no launcher routing, `USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE: 'true'` for MTP.
- `MODELS(_zh).md`: links into `configs/deprecated/` become plain text; present-tense "archived in" statements now say the archive was removed.
- Delete `benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/deprecated/` (archived `models*.yaml`, `node_excludes.yaml`, `glm5_setup.sh`); nothing loads them, the live registries sit beside it in `amd_utils/`. configuration-procedures now says retired AMD registry entries are deleted too.

## Test plan
- [x] `generate_sweep_configs.py full-sweep` over both master configs passes (it fails on `main` because of the `cluster:b300-nv` power-ab keys this PR deletes); the three trimmed ATOM configs generate 23 GPU-resident srt points; no single-node agentic entry without `srt-recipe:` remains.
- [x] `bash -n` on the three edited launchers and `server_sglang.sh`.
- [x] `utils/test_srt_single_node.py`, `utils/test_srt_cluster_config.py`, `utils/matrix_logic`, `utils/changelog_gate_tests`: 439 passed, 14 failed, identical failure set on `main` (pool-launcher tests hit `mapfile: command not found` on macOS bash 3.2).
- No `perf-changelog.yaml` change, so no sweep is triggered.

title: [Klaud Cold] Delete benchmarks/single_node/fixed_seq_len and configs/deprecated
body:
## Summary
Delete the last legacy single-node benchmark and config archives, and every live pointer to them:

1. **`benchmarks/single_node/fixed_seq_len/`** (110 files, all under `deprecated/`). Since the single-node SRT-only cutover (2026-09-22) every active fixed-sequence config runs as an srt-slurm recipe; nothing executes or sources these scripts.
2. **`configs/deprecated/{amd,nvidia}-master.yaml`**. Nothing reads them (no code, workflow or test); they were historical archives.

### Policy change: retired configs are deleted, not archived
- `AGENTS.md` "Deprecating benchmark configs", `docs/configuration-procedures(_zh).md` and the Claude review prompt in `.github/workflows/claude.yml` now say: delete retired entries (or only the retired scenarios); git history and `perf-changelog.yaml` are the record. Unused recipes/setup scripts are deleted rather than moved to a `deprecated/` directory.

### Docs moved to the srt-slurm recipe flow
- `.claude/commands/add-model-hardware.md` (the add-model-hardware skill): produce an srt-slurm recipe + master entry with `srt-recipe:` + changelog; no bash script, no launcher routing (variant selection via `infx/srt_slurm/single_node.py::select_recipe`); `USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE: 'true'` for MTP; dropped the retired in-place MiniMax-M3 ROCm EAGLE3 patch step.
- `docs/configuration-procedures(_zh).md` new-config steps 2/3/6 and sources line likewise.

### Pointers
- `MODELS(_zh).md`: links into `configs/deprecated/` become plain text; present-tense "archived in / live in" statements now say the archive was removed (dated history otherwise unchanged).
- `KLAUD_DEBUG.md` example pointer dropped (identical to the same line in #3463, so the two merge cleanly); `benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/deprecated/models_vllm.yaml` comment updated.

Not changed: `SCENARIO_SUBDIR: fixed_seq_len/` in the workflows is a path fragment still consumed by the launchers' generic bash fallback (no active config reaches it); removing that fallback across all launchers is a separate cleanup.

## Test plan
- [x] `git grep` finds no reference to `configs/deprecated` or `single_node/fixed_seq_len` outside dated MODELS history and `perf-changelog.yaml`.
- [x] `utils/test_srt_single_node.py`, `utils/test_srt_cluster_config.py`, `utils/matrix_logic`, `utils/changelog_gate_tests`: 439 passed, 14 failed — same set as `main` (pool-launcher tests hit `mapfile` on macOS bash 3.2).

- No config or `perf-changelog.yaml` change, so no sweep is triggered.

title: [AgentX] DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 llm-d on GB200
body:
## Changes

- Run DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 AgentX on `cluster:gb200-nv`: aggregated TP8/DEP8 on 2 nodes (8 GPUs), or 1P-DEP8/1D-DEP8 on 4 nodes (16 GPUs).
- Pin the patched DSpark ARM64 image and report its bundled llm-d router v0.10.0. Keep native context and golden AL: K5/3.61 for aggregate/decode, K1/1.84 for disaggregated prefill; accuracy evals use real verification.
- Declare Mooncake DRAM offloading only for the offload variants, using 60% of available CPU DRAM; SSD offloading is disabled.
- Use the GB200 launcher and thin wrappers. Discovery excludes headless TP followers and supplies vLLM metrics endpoints to AIPerf. Remove the B200 launcher changes and binary overrides.

## Validation

Generated GB200 matrices have 2-node aggregate and 4-node disaggregated allocations. Live sweep validation is in progress; no successful GPU result is claimed yet.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Touches multi-node serving (Mooncake master, KV connectors, SLURM env contract) and benchmark invariants (golden AL, offload metadata); mostly benchmark infra but misconfiguration could fail jobs or skew metrics.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds **DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 AgentX** on GB200 via **llm-d** (`cluster:gb200-nv`): master configs for **aggregated** TP8/DEP8 (2 nodes) and **1P-DEP8/1D-DEP8** disagg (4 nodes), plus GB200 **DSpark** recipes (prefix/token-load EPP, optional **Mooncake** DRAM offload).
>

## Description

unconditionally). Today this recipe reduces `--max-num-batched-tokens` to
4096/8192 at TP=2 c64+ and TP=4/TP=2 c128+ to free indexer/KV headroom (see
the comment this replaces, and run `35574132719`). This PR removes that
reduction so both engines run the identical prefill chunk, and unpins
`image` to `TBD` since the prior pin predates and is unrelated to this
change — a maintainer should pick a validated image when repinning.

**This is a draft.** The KV-headroom regression this previously guarded
against (TP=2 c64+/c128+, TP=4 c128) has **not** been re-validated at 16384
on this SKU. Before taking this out of draft, a full sweep needs to confirm
prefix-cache hit rate / TTFT / decode throughput don't regress at those
points the way they did before this recipe added the reduction.

title: Test H100 ModelScope loading from empty caches / 测试 H100 ModelScope 冷缓存加载
body:
## Description

Add H100 BF16 coverage for `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` through ModelScope. Every job starts with a verified-empty ModelScope cache and an independent empty HF cache. `trtllm-serve` downloads the remote model itself; the benchmark then uses the tokenizer from that same local snapshot. Snapshot reports record file sizes and SHA256 and reject unexpected HF fallback files.

**[Full PR sweep passed](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35544218778)** on `e78910cb90fd425ef538e244c89e5524da161598`, with `full-sweep-enabled`. [Complete artifact audit](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3324#issuecomment-5753552101).

- Full GSM8K c32: **870/1,319 strict (65.9591%)**, 878/1,319 flexible (66.5656%).
- Full GSM8K c64: **884/1,319 strict (67.0205%)**, 889/1,319 flexible (67.3995%).

title: Add Qwen3.8-27B native MTP golden AL/AR for FP8 and BF16 / 新增 FP8 和 BF16 的 Qwen3.8-27B 原生 MTP 黄金 AL/AR
body:
Add measured Qwen3.8-27B **native MTP** golden AL/AR curves for **FP8 and BF16 targets, draft lengths 1–4, thinking off/on**. All 16 cells completed every SPEED-Bench Qualitative coding prompt: 80 requests per cell, **1,280 successes and zero failures**. AL includes the bonus token; AR is accepted draft tokens divided by actual proposed tokens.

| Thinking | Draft tokens | FP8 AL | FP8 AR | BF16 AL | BF16 AR |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| off | 1 | 1.90 | 90.04% | 1.91 | 91.11% |
| off | 2 | 2.68 | 83.78% | 2.66 | 82.93% |
| off | 3 | 3.28 | 75.96% | 3.27 | 75.56% |
| off | 4 | 3.79 | 69.85% | 3.78 | 69.40% |
| on | 1 | 1.73 | 72.67% | 1.73 | 73.22% |
| on | 2 | 2.21 | 60.50% | 2.21 | 60.41% |
| on | 3 | 2.52 | 50.70% | 2.51 | 50.25% |
| on | 4 | 2.72 | 43.07% | 2.72 | 42.89% |

The two golden YAMLs retain AL values, precise AR fractions, raw counters, model revisions, sampling settings, dataset hash, and source runs:
- `golden_al_distribution/qwen3.827b_fp8_mtp.yaml`
- `golden_al_distribution/qwen3.827b_bf16_mtp.yaml`

Measurement: H200, TP1, concurrency 64, 16,384-token context, maximum output 4,096, seed 0, FP8 target KV cache, and Qwen model-card sampling for each thinking mode. Both target precisions use the original BF16 native MTP head and draft KV cache. The prepared dataset hash is identical across all four runs. Server logs, model inspection, request outputs, exact commands, and unrounded counters remain in each run's `speedbench-evidence` artifact.

| Target | Thinking off | Thinking on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FP8 | [35492786441](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492786441) | [35492787451](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492787451) |
| BF16 | [35492788796](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492788796) | [35492789880](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492789880) |

The official FP8 checkpoint quantizes its embedded MTP tensors. The collector therefore loads the original BF16 head from `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` at `1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0`. The pinned vLLM loader also inherits target quantization for the MTP modules, so the collector explicitly excludes all original MTP weight modules using supported `--hf-overrides`. Runtime inspection confirms unquantized MTP linear modules. The FP8 target remains the official checkpoint at `017b9c7af6b5689d5dd426a76e0bc077eb5ca20a`.

The workflow now accepts explicit precision, TP, checkpoint revision, and collector/draft configuration; the existing H200 pool launcher supports the collector override. Priority jobs always request `nodes:1`. The Qwen collector rejects draft lengths outside 1–4 before model downloads, rejects incomplete cells or invalid counters, and keeps runtime directories under `/tmp` before staging final files.

Validation: 14 behavioral tests; Ruff check/format, Bash syntax, ShellCheck, actionlint, and Zizmor passed. The actual Bash collector rejected k=5 before download. All 16 measured cells passed artifact checks; AL/AR agree with vLLM's independent report, and the committed AL values match the workflow matrices. Generated text was inspected for both thinking modes. Related FP8 MTP recipes: [#3292](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3292), [#3293](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3293).

## AI model disclosure

Prepared by GPT-6 (implementation, source inspection, measurement orchestration, and validation). The exact runtime model/version identifier could not be verified. No delegated agents were used.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

新增 Qwen3.8-27B 的**原生 MTP** 黄金 AL/AR 曲线，覆盖 **FP8 和 BF16 目标模型、1–4 个草稿 token，以及 thinking 关闭/开启两种模式**。全部 16 个测量点均完成 SPEED-Bench Qualitative coding 类别的全部提示词：每点 80 次请求，共 **1,280 次成功、零失败**。AL 包含目标模型的保证 token；AR 为接受的草稿 token 数除以实际提出的草稿 token 数。完整数值见上表。

两个黄金 YAML（`qwen3.827b_fp8_mtp.yaml`、`qwen3.827b_bf16_mtp.yaml`）保留 AL、精确 AR 比例、原始计数器、模型版本、采样设置、数据集哈希和来源运行。

测量配置：H200、TP1、并发 64、上下文 16,384 token、最大输出 4,096 token、seed 0、FP8 目标 KV cache，以及模型卡规定的各 thinking 模式采样参数。两种目标精度均使用原始 BF16 原生 MTP 头和 BF16 草稿 KV cache。四次运行处理后的数据集哈希一致。上表链接的工作流 `speedbench-evidence` artifact 保留服务日志、模型检查、逐请求输出、精确命令和未舍入计数器。

官方 FP8 checkpoint 同时量化了内嵌 MTP 张量。因此收集器加载 `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` 在 revision `1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0` 的原始 BF16 MTP 头。固定版本的 vLLM loader 还会把目标量化配置传给 MTP 模块，因此通过受支持的 `--hf-overrides` 显式排除全部原始 MTP 权重模块。运行时检查确认 MTP 线性模块未量化。FP8 目标使用官方 checkpoint revision `017b9c7af6b5689d5dd426a76e0bc077eb5ca20a`。

工作流支持显式传入精度、TP、checkpoint revision，以及收集器和草稿配置；现有 H200 池 launcher 支持指定收集器。优先级任务始终请求 `nodes:1`。Qwen 收集器在下载模型前拒绝超出 1–4 范围的草稿长度，拒绝未完成的测量点或无效计数器，并在 `/tmp` 中创建运行目录，最后仅暂存输出文件。

验证：14 项行为测试，以及 Ruff 检查与格式检查、Bash 语法、ShellCheck、actionlint、Zizmor 均通过。实际 Bash 收集器在下载前拒绝了 k=5。全部 16 个测量点通过 artifact 核对，AL/AR 与 vLLM 独立报告一致，提交的 AL 数值与工作流矩阵一致，并检查了两种 thinking 模式的生成文本。相关 FP8 MTP 配方：[#3292](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3292)、[#3293](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3293)。

AI 模型披露：由 GPT-6 完成实现、源码核查、测量编排和验证；无法核实运行时精确模型及版本标识。未使用委派代理。

</details>
